## Definition of done
- [ ] Implemented (no placeholder behaviour presented as a feature)
- [ ] Automated tests added/updated and passing (`make verify`)
- [ ] Security checklist reviewed (docs/09 §8): authz on every endpoint, validated DTOs, no secrets/PII in logs, ownership from principal
- [ ] Docs updated (relevant docs/*.md, API/DB docs if changed, CHANGELOG)
- [ ] `docs/19-PROJECT-PROGRESS.md` updated (done / in-progress / pending / debt)
- [ ] New dependency? Justified in an ADR (docs/17) and checked for licence/CVEs
- [ ] DB change? Flyway migration, backward compatible (expand/contract)
